paragraphs: AssetWorks builds software, hardware and consulting services for organizations whose work centers on assets and infrastructure. The buyers run commercial fleets or public infrastructure and want to control operating costs.

The fleet system, FleetFocus, is a central platform for maintenance, asset lifecycle tracking, fueling and reporting. A companion product, FuelFocus, watches fuel levels and transactions in real time so discrepancies surface immediately. A mobile extension puts inventory and work order management in the hands of technicians and storekeepers. A Power BI connection supports custom dashboards, advanced reporting and lifecycle analytics on the same data.

The company puts its own history at more than 40 years and the home page counts over 1,000 organizations using the products. Listed offices include one in Berwyn, Pennsylvania and a San Antonio location for education facilities, real estate and planning software. Case studies describe a county internal services department managing roughly 20,000 vehicles. Another covers a regional public transit agency running a fleet of more than 427 active vehicles.
